_about.purpose: Typical adult reference intervals, used ONLY to tell analytes apart when mapping an unknown printed name onto a canonical analyte.
_about.not_for: Clinical interpretation. A result is flagged normal/low/high strictly from the interval printed on the patient's own report (src/normalize.py), never from this file.
_about.precision_needed: Order of magnitude. The job is to separate homocysteine (5-15 umol/l) from uric acid (202-417 umol/l), not to decide whether a patient is ill.
_about.provenance: Seeded from commonly published adult intervals. NOT verified against a Czech clinical source. Before this is relied on beyond a demo it should be checked against CSKB recommendations or a lab handbook, and per-lab or per-doctor overrides added.
_about.units: Each range is expressed in the analyte's canonical_unit as declared in registry.json.
